item.title: EplayerX 1.2.41
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 修复搜索结果分页与历史记录恢复问题，改善切换隐私模式后的搜索结果隔离。 - 改善下载任务的删除、重试和异常恢复，减少重启后任务状态不一致的问题。 - 改善播放画质增强的兼容性，在不支持的播放场景中隐藏 SDR → HDR 选项。 - 改善网盘媒体刮削与同步的稳定性。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Fixed search pagination and history restoration, and improved search result separation when switching privacy modes. - Improved download deletion, retries, and recovery to keep task states consistent after restarting the app. - Improved video enhancement compatibility and hid the SDR → HDR option in unsupported playback scenarios. - Improved the reliability of cloud drive media scraping and synchronization.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
